acceptance_criteria: Plot markers and unified output attributes validate, load, and serialize coherently within the assigned schema and output surfaces.
Plot templates end with a newline, embedded HTML starts with a doctype, and generated plots do not force a zero-valued Y-axis.
Metrics and params diff support tabulated Markdown output, repository diff handles repositories without commits, and completion entries match the resulting CLI.
Focused plot, output, DVC-file, diff, metrics, and params tests pass.
contract.outcome: Implement plot markers and plural plots behavior, unified dvc.yaml output serialization, plot rendering and template changes, diff behavior, Markdown output, and shell completion updates.

acceptance_criteria: Stage commit and checkout/run refactors preserve output safety while removing obsolete check_can_commit behavior.
Dry-run performs no mutations, locked imports suppress the unwanted warning, and default-target logging uses debug level.
Run cache supports uncached files and is collected correctly by push and pull using the renamed terminology.
Recursive update and import URL edge cases are covered, and focused stage, run, reproduce, commit, checkout, update, and import tests pass.
contract.outcome: Implement stage, run, reproduce, commit, checkout, update, and import behavior, including dry-run correctness, locked-import logging, run-cache terminology and uncached-file handling, recursive update, and cache collection through push and pull.

acceptance_criteria: Utilities accept tree-backed file objects without assuming local os.path-only semantics.
RepoTree and DvcTree open cached content as streams and can pull missing cache content through the configured remote.
Remote default validation and S3 SSEKMSKeyId mapping behave correctly.
Focused tree, utility, external-repository, data-cloud, configuration, and mocked remote tests pass.
contract.outcome: Implement GitTree-aware utility behavior, RepoTree and DvcTree streaming and pull fallback, remote validation and fixture-related behavior, and S3 SSE-KMS configuration support.
